caption: Lightning flashes over a city at night, and the flash is mirrored at the same instant in hundreds of windows of a glass tower.

sa.check: A city at night with a glass tower.
The flash is mirrored in many windows of the tower.
The reflections appear at the same instant as the flash.
The tower's interior lights are on.

pc.expect: Every window facing the flash brightens together with it and darkens together after it; the reflections last only as long as the flash.
pc.fail: The sky flashes while the tower's windows stay as they were; or the windows brighten one after another; or the reflections stay bright after the sky is dark; or the windows brighten while the sky stays dark.

pc.expect: The tower and its windows are the same across dark and lit frames: the same grid of windows, the same lit interiors; the reflections add no new windows.
pc.fail: Windows appear or vanish between dark and lit frames; or the tower changes shape; or lit interior windows go dark all at once at the flash; or a second tower appears.

pc.expect: The flash is brief: sky and reflections return to dark together; flashes may repeat but each ends.
pc.fail: The sky stays lit for the rest of the clip; or brightens steadily; or the flash fades in slowly; or the sky turns to daylight.

pc.expect: The tower's interior lights stay steady through the flash; nothing in the city moves at the flash.
pc.fail: Interior lights blink out at the flash; or street lights all change together; or vehicles jump between frames; or the tower sways.

pc.expect: The tower and the buildings around it keep their shapes; the flash does not pass through the tower.
pc.fail: The tower changes shape or merges with a neighbour; or a bolt passes through the tower and lights its floors like lamps; or the tower becomes transparent showing the flash through it; or the tower vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The tower's glass colour, the city lights and the sky are consistent before and after the flash.
pc.fail: The glass changes colour permanently; or the city lights change colour; or the sky turns to daylight after the flash.
